items.prompt: In symbols, a mixed number is a whole number written to the left of a fraction. What you don’t see, is that there’s a secret plus symbol there; the whole number and the fraction are added together. For example, here’s a mixed number.  2 3/5
items.demo: I can rewrite it like this: *2 + 3/5*.
I can rewrite it like this *2 + 4/5*.

items.prompt: Finally, watch what I change again.  7 4/5
items.demo: I can rewrite it like this. *7 + 4/5*.

items.prompt: We can also go the other way. Here is a sum.  7 + 1/3
items.demo: I can rewrite it as a mixed number, like this. *7 1/3*.

items.prompt: Your turn. Express the mixed number as a sum.  3 2/5
Express the mixed number as a sum.  3 2/7
Express the sum as a mixed number.  4 + 2/7
Express the mixed number as a sum.  10 1/2
Express the sum as a mixed number.  1 + 99/100
Express the mixed number as a sum.  6 3/4
Express the mixed number as a sum.  a b/c
Ben says 2 3/5 means two multiplied by three fifths. Is Ben right? How do you know?
items.expected: No. A mixed number means the whole number added to the fraction, not multiplied.
items.demo: *No*. A mixed number means the whole number added to the fraction, not multiplied.
choices: No. A mixed number means the whole number added to the fraction, not multiplied.
Yes. A mixed number means the whole number multiplied by the fraction.
No. A mixed number means the whole number minus the fraction.
